description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 Strikes ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Special Attack: Don't Let the Door Hit Ya
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> automatically triggers upon conclusion if at least 3 <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> exist on the field:
Hurls a hammer at enemies on the field, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
<color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> hit by this skill will be detonated, generating tornadoes based on the number of Wind Eyes hit that continuously track enemies and deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.desc:

Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Giving Back
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Excuse Me
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Watch for the Chill
EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch Out for Wind Chill]</color> automatically activates upon conclusion and is not considered an EX Special Attack:
Consumes all <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
For each point of <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> consumed, deals an additional instance of <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> after the attack and generates 1 <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> in place;
When <color=#ffffff>[Windswept]</color> is triggered on enemies during this skill, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Eye of the Storm
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> Generated after consuming <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, lasts 30 seconds;
<color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> can exist up to 9 at a time. When the limit is exceeded, the earliest generated <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> will automatically detonate;
When hit by <color=#ffffff>[Special Attack: No Need to See You Off]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Requiem of the Burial Night]</color>, they will be detonated. If fewer than 3 are hit simultaneously, each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> position will generate 1 small tornado that tracks enemies and deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, lasting 1 second;
If 3 are hit simultaneously, 1 large tornado will be generated as a replacement, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, lasting 1 second.
When detonated by any means, <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> deals one instance of <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to nearby enemies.

description.desc:
When a <color=#ffffff>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, restore 1 <color=#ffffff>Wind Energy</color>.

description.name: Ultimate: Requiem of the Buried Night
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:

description.name: Defensive Assist: Got Your Back
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:

This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Points]</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Midnight Protocol
description.desc:
After using <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

1.name: All-Round Attendant
1.desc: <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> On hit, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 40s; increases own CRIT DMG by 30%.
1.desc2:
Roxy always manages to keep everything in perfect order—from the whimsical household head's daily needs to her frequent spur-of-the-moment impulses.
"If you absolutely insist on going, please take this guidebook with you. Yes, I knew the young lady would make such a decision."
"You've changed your mind? No worries—here's another guidebook, specifically prepared for exactly this situation."

2.name: Never Overtime
2.desc: For each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated, the next <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> deals 5% more Daze, up to a max of 15%. When <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> is launched and enters <color=#ffffff>[Spin]</color> state to switch characters, Roxy maintains the <color=#ffffff>[Spin]</color> state for 0.25s without consuming Energy, up to a max of 0.75s. When <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> hits an enemy, increases the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 25%, lasting until the target recovers from the Stunned state.
2.desc2:
Her pale complexion and perpetual dark circles are testament to the heart and soul Roxy pours into her workshop.
She often sees Vyrium at four in the morning—not because she's a night owl, but because she simply never stops working.
For her, clocking out is as distant as a myth.
"Ah... sunrise again... Feels like the reality of leaving work will never arrive."

3.name: Insomniac Tales
3.desc2:
Roxy always makes thorough plans, but any plan involving the Lady never keeps up with reality—endless Schedule changes, endless revisions...
Even the perfect assistant couldn't help but get agitated, until she hit a certain breaking point—she snapped.
From then on, Vyrium gained a terrifying Late Night wanderer.
"I just wanna go home... and get a good night's sleep—!"

4.name: R.I.P
4.desc: When launching <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Roxy recovers 1 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; when <color=#ffffff>[Dodge Counter: Giving Back]</color> hits an enemy, recovers 2 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Requiem of the Buried Night]</color> DMG increases by 25%, and Daze increases by 10%.
4.desc2:
Every time Roxy busts out her weapon, enemies are left scratching their heads: who in their right mind fights with a coffin?
Their confusion never lasts long, though.
The moment the Young Lady casually swings it through the air, tearing out a heavy, howling gust, they get the message loud and clear: that thing definitely isn't meant for lying down and taking a nap.
"I know it's still daytime, but sorry— it's time to say goodnight."

5.name: Second Heartbeat
5.desc2:
Roxy can no longer recall that childhood Adventure, and the pain of losing her heart has long since faded.
But she'll never forget how the Young Lady once hailed as a genius cried those proud eyes red, calling her name over and over,
tears falling on her ice-cold chest, nearly burning a hole where her heart should be.
"Because of this Porcelloy heart... I get a little anemic sometimes, but with Miss by my side, there's nothing to worry about."

6.name: Eternity and the Clockwork Automaton
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, DMG dealt by self ignores 30% of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG RES</color>; when <color=#ffffff>[Special Attack: Don't Bother Seeing Me Out]</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> to generate a large tornado, the main target is granted the <color=#ffffff>[Vengeance]</color> effect, generating a large tornado at the target's position once every 3 seconds, for a total of 4 additional large tornadoes; the DMG Multiplier of large tornadoes is increased by 400%, and the Daze dealt is increased by 100%. On repeated triggers, the additional generation count stacks.
6.desc2:
Some believed Roxy only stayed by the family head's side to maintain her Porcelloy Heart—that Flint had used his bloodline to shackle a capable assistant.
Roxy was long accustomed to such talk, not even bothering to refute it. The other party involved, however, had once been deeply unsettled by it.
During a lull in a busy day, she feigned nonchalance and brought it up with her assistant. All she got in reply was a weary sigh.
"No, I've never thought that way. Being alive is more than enough—I've always been grateful to you, Miss."
"Besides... if you'll pardon my saying so, isn't it you who's bound by your bloodline, Miss?"
"So that's what's been keeping you on edge lately... Rather than idle rumors, perhaps you'd be better off worrying about that bold promise you made to the CCD not long ago—the excessive Porcelloy order."
